text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I train at summer 
training camp, I don't improve. All that 
comes to mind... is a vision of myself 
growing more fragile day by day, never 
able to become Maruzensky's rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, after being invited by Yaeno 
Muteki to watch a race, they witness 
Mejiro Ardan's triumphant comeback and see 
that she has grown even stronger than 
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...It was a stark contrast to how she was 
now. Sakura Chiyono O realized she could 
never go back to the way she was before, 
and ran away."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Maruzensky caught up to her as 
she ran away. The one she looked up to 
understood. Even if you can't return to 
your prime, you just have to discover a 
new version of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because in doing so, she had overcome her 
own limits. Having found a rival in Sakura 
Chiyono O, she drew upon the fire lit in 
her heart... refusing to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If you're Maruzensky's rival, let your 
heart burn bright without running from 
what lies before you. The time to steel 
her resolve had finally come for Sakura 
Chiyono O.
